Interview Experience
Oracle 2023
Pratham Loya
23.08.2023
Final Year IT (2020-24)

INTRODUCTION
Role - Associate Application Developer
Organization - Oracle Financial Software Services Ltd.
Eligibility: Circuit Branches(CS, IT, EXTC, Electronics, Electrical)
CGPA - 7+ | No Backlogs | 12th - 70% | 10th - 70%
Location - Mumbai / Pune / Bangalore / Chennai
Salary - 19.1 CTC ( Base-14.5 + 20K Stocks(25% redemption every year) + PF )
HIRING WORKFLOW
1. Online Test
2. PPT ( TPO Seminar Hall )
3. Technical Interview
4. Tech + HR Interview
ONLINE TEST
Hackerrank Platform (Online)| 5:00 PM 10/8/23 | 100 mins | 22 Questions
1. Coding (1): Leetcode - Medium | Similar to this -> link
2. Aptitude (10)
3. Grammar (10)
4. REST API (1)
Tip: Don’t make silly mistakes in Aptitude & Grammar Coz that factor influences score
I did solve the coding question (All test cases passed) with Aptitude & Grammar.
I was not ready for the REST API question hence was not able to do it. But later figured
out it was left by most of my peers so that wasn't a deal breaker.
55 Students were shortlisted for 2 Roles (40 + 15).
1

TECHNICAL INTERVIEW
TPO (Offline)| ~ 45 Mins
1. Introduction + Internship Experience
2. Tree Traversals(DFS): How it works and How would you implement them ?
I gave them a recursive approach of DFS(Inorder, preorder, postorder) on paper.
3. Linked List Vs Array ? Which is better & Why ? How much better ?
4. Inserting an element in the middle of Array Vs Linked List. Which is better ? By
How much? Now this question is simple but the catch was he wanted me to use
the best approach hence this was a question about the middle of the linked list. I
was able to catch that and gave him both time and space complexity of both
approaches.
5. What is Inheritance ? Why use It ? I gave a real life example and illustrated how it
helps in code reusability.
6. He gave me 2 SQL questions on JOIN and SELF-JOIN operations. And I gave both
answers on paper.
7. He finally wanted me to find an element in a sorted array. I know this is a straight
question of binary search but in the interview I used striver’s method
(brute-better-optimal) to explain code. So I started with linear search and then he
asked me if I could optimize it then I explained binary search. Then he asked me
to write it on paper.
8. Why Oracle ? pay attention to Company PPT.
Tips:
Prepare for Interview:
Introduction | DSA(till Trees) | SQL | HR Ques |DBMS | OS
At any point the interviewer can ask you to write the code for whatever to tell them so
don’t mention things that you are not confident about.
2

TECH + HR INTERVIEW
TPO (Offline) | ~ 45 Mins
1. Firstly, the interviewer introduced himself, followed by my introduction.
2. You have a decent CGPA, why don’t you want to do a masters ?
I answered that getting more hands on coding experience along with learning side
by side while working could lead to a better learning compared to doing masters.
And also mentioned that oracle provides free courses and perks (Company PPT).
3. Then he went through my resume and asked me questions on REST API, React.
He at one point also asked me to draw screens on paper and show how react
works (Nearly 20-25 mins).
4. Then he asked me if I had any questions for him ?
How do you learn a new tech stack from scratch ? (He mentioned in his
introduction that he had worked on many tech-stacks)
If someone gets stuck on some error and can’t find any resources on the web. How
to tackle this kind of situation at Oracle ?
Tips:
Be very clear about things that you have mentioned in Resume. Questions can be asked
on projects as well as tech stacks and they test how good you know the concepts running
behind it.
RESULT
19 Students were selected and luckily I was one of them.
Thank You
3
